svg.title: sparse-quest
svg.desc: Toy Quest example with a 4-channel query q = (2, −1, 1, 1) and four pages of four keys. Each page stores per-channel min and max of its keys. The bound U_p is A 6, B 4, C 1, D 5; true best scores A 6, B 3, C -1, D 3. Top-2 by bound: A and D. Real scale: 32K context in 16-token pages is 2,048 pages; a 2,048-token budget reads 128 pages (6.25%); metadata adds 12.5% to K. Reported 7.03× self-attention speedup at 32K.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: Up = Σi max(qi mp,i , qi Mp,i ) ≥ maxj ∈ p q⊤ kj
bars: [min, max] per channel (axis −2…2) · green: top-2 by U, read exactly
